name: Machida Aki
source:
A girl of the same grade as the [url=/c94459]protagonist[/url]. She is in the school's light music band with [url=/c94462]Kiyokawa Ren[/url], and is a popular with both men and women. Aki is one of the daughters of a millionaire director. She has been a close friend of Ren since the cat incident a few years ago. 

[Translared from Getchu and Side Story.]
